name: langsmith-qa-dashboard
description: Full stack LangSmith QA Dashboard — FastAPI backend + Astro.js frontend

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && WATCHFILES_FORCE_POLLING=true uv run uvicorn main:app --reload --reload-dir models --reload-dir routers --reload-dir services --port 8000
scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npm run dev
scripts.install: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
